title: Engineering Loop Standard Configuration
description: Formal schema for engineering-loop.json, the single source of truth an Engineering Loop Standard adapter is generated from.

$schema.description: Pointer back to this schema, for editor validation.

version.description: Version of the Engineering Loop Standard this config conforms to, in semver.

architecture_style.description: Free-text label, e.g. modular-monolith, microservices, monorepo, cli-tool.

directory.description: Path, relative to the project root, holding persistent memory files.

required_files.description: Filenames that must exist inside the memory directory.

pipeline.description: Ordered phase names run before and after code changes. Phase names are free-text so tools can extend them.

commands.description: Shell commands an agent should run for each verification step.

language_policy.description: ISO 639-1 language codes required for each artifact category.

agents.description: Behavioral limits applied to any agent following this config.

allow_auto_fix.description: Whether an agent may automatically repair failing tests/lint without asking first.

max_repair_iterations.description: Upper bound on Phase 7 (Self-Healing) retry loops before an agent must stop and ask for help.

adapters.description: Adapters to generate when running `engineering-loop init` or `engineering-loop sync`.
